I haven't set up the Monday 08:00 digest. I replied to you in #coastal-team saying so.

The reason is that scheduled jobs created from this session can't post into Slack. Their output stays local, so a recurring post would not run reliably. I also can't reliably check each digest for finance figures ahead of time, and the rules require that check before anything goes into #coastal-team or #coastal-random.

What I can do: draft the digest for you to review before each Monday, starting 19 October, or post it when you ask. For the automatic version, Ruth or the ops side would need to set up a scheduled delivery route first.
